iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

check
       Set the iRule validation level.

SYNOPSIS
DESCRIPTION
       Set the iRule validation level:
	   - none: disable the validation.
	   - syntax: only validate iRule syntax, no dependency check.
	   - config: only dependency check, no syntax check.
	   - strict: this is the default. Both syntax and depdendency are checked.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-4.0.0 - first introduced the command
